page.layout: One printed page: the e-rara.ch digitiser's cover sheet. Top right logo; centred title block; below a rule, a block of digitiser notes in German, English, French and Italian, a second rule, and the terms-of-use block; bottom right the Visual Library logo. No book text on this scan.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not printed book text, so it is left out of the transcription. Title information as shown on the sheet: "In historiam passionis et sepulturae Domini nostri Jesu Christi. Homiliae Theodori Bezae, ex gallicis latinae factae. Additus est index rerum memorabilium." Author: Bèze, Théodore de. Place and date: [Genève], 1592. Holding: Bibliothèque de Genève, Shelf Mark Bd 439. Persistent link: https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-6668. The logos, banner links and licence notices belong to the digitiser and are not transcribed.
